hook: Why was this train allowed to move?

slides.title: Spain's 'inexplicable' order
slides.image_prompt: Empty high-speed railway tracks stretching across a flat dry Spanish plain at dusk, a single red signal light glowing beside the line
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
At least 68 dead as a train hits a stopped one.
WHY IT MATTERS
Minister calls letting it restart 'inexplicable'; probe ongoing.
FOR YOU
Madrid–Andalusia high-speed trains are suspended, so check any booking on that route.
slides.body: At least 68 dead as a train hits a stopped one. Minister calls letting it restart 'inexplicable'; probe ongoing. Madrid–Andalusia high-speed trains are suspended, so check any booking on that route.

slides.title: Israel vote: no majority yet
slides.image_prompt: Two stacks of ballot envelopes on a wooden table, neither tall enough to reach a marked line, under soft parliament lighting
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Partial count: Netanyahu's bloc 53, Eisenkot's bloc 48.
WHY IT MATTERS
Neither reaches 61; Arab-led parties hold a record 19.
FOR YOU
Seat numbers may still shift once special double-envelope ballots are counted.
slides.body: Partial count: Netanyahu's bloc 53, Eisenkot's bloc 48. Neither reaches 61; Arab-led parties hold a record 19. Seat numbers may still shift once special double-envelope ballots are counted.

slides.title: Fed holds rates, 2 want hikes
slides.image_prompt: A brass balance scale perfectly level on a marble desk, a small stack of coins on each side, cool morning light
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
The Fed kept rates at 3.75–4.00% on Wednesday.
WHY IT MATTERS
Two officials wanted a hike: 'Inflation remains elevated.'
FOR YOU
US borrowing costs stay put for now; the next decision comes in December.
slides.body: The Fed kept rates at 3.75–4.00% on Wednesday. Two officials wanted a hike: 'Inflation remains elevated.' US borrowing costs stay put for now; the next decision comes in December.

slides.title: Bolsonaro lands in Miami
slides.image_prompt: A small private jet parked on a sunny tarmac with palm trees, an open empty suitcase resting on the ground beside the stairs
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Flávio Bolsonaro flew to Miami despite a passport order.
WHY IT MATTERS
He faces a money-laundering probe; he denies wrongdoing.
FOR YOU
Lula called leaving 'shameful'; Bolsonaro plans a Miami press conference Thursday.
slides.body: Flávio Bolsonaro flew to Miami despite a passport order. He faces a money-laundering probe; he denies wrongdoing. Lula called leaving 'shameful'; Bolsonaro plans a Miami press conference Thursday.

slides.title: Brewers win first World Series
slides.image_prompt: A gleaming trophy beside a baseball and glove on infield dirt under bright stadium lights, confetti scattered on the grass
slides.label: SPORT
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay 4–1 to take the series 4–1.
WHY IT MATTERS
First title since the club was founded in 1969.
FOR YOU
Long droughts do end: thousands of fans traveled 1,300 miles to see it.
slides.body: Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay 4–1 to take the series 4–1. First title since the club was founded in 1969. Long droughts do end: thousands of fans traveled 1,300 miles to see it.
